'''Muz's Shop''' was a shop on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] owned by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] named [[Muz]]. In this shop Muz fenced stolen goods and supplies. [[Cade Skywalker]] took some stolen [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] shipments here and sold them to Muz, under the name of his late ancestor: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
